blocks.text: Yeh Pakistan ke maidanon ka sab se wasee khushki ka ecosystem hai, xerophytic (khushk saali bardasht) paudon ke saath jin ke kaante sabzi khoron ko rokte aur paani ka nuqsan kam karte hain.

rows: Indus maidan: Punjab ka zyada hissa (Bahawalpur, Khanewal, Mianwali, Dera Ghazi Khan), Indus ke saath junoobi Sindh, maghribi Balochistan
khushk se neem khushk; garmiyon mein 50 C tak
Prosopis cineraria (jhand, kandi), Salvadora oleoides (peelu, wan), Capparis aphylla (karir), Vachellia nilotica (kikar)
oont, houbara bustard, chinkara, gidar, Balochistan gerbil, sehi aur saanp (maslan saw-scaled viper)
bohat kharab: zyada tar qudrati jangal abadiyon aur nehri kheti ke liye kaat diye gaye

blocks.alt: Khushk maidan ka manzar, ghaas wali dhalwanon par kanton wale darakht aur jhaariyan. Labels: door oont, darakht ke neeche charta chinkara, chattanon ke paas sahi (porcupine), khushk jagah par kundli maare saanp, ghaas mein Balochistan gerbils aur surkh phoolon wali karir ki jhaariyan.
blocks.caption: Figure 25.12: Tropical thorn jangal aur us ke numainda paude aur janwar (kitab ki tasveer, Figure 25.12, ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ke paudon aur janwaron ki fehrist aur tasveer mein rattlesnake hai, lekin rattlesnake (dum par jhunjhuna) sirf America mein milta hai, Pakistan mein nahi. Is liye khaake mein saanp baghair jhunjhune ke bana hai. Pakistan ke thorn jangal ka mashhoor zehreela saanp saw-scaled viper (Echis carinatus) hai jo kundli maar kar khurdari aawaz nikalta hai.
